title: Raster, color, and publication custody
description: Typed artifact contracts and mechanism ports for every mechanism in Section 2 of the v4 mechanism census.

artifactTypes.label: Supplied encoded opaque image
artifactTypes.description: The exact supplied encoded image file whose declared content has no genuine transparency.
sourceNotes: Defined from the encoded opaque file input at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:89.
provenanceNotes: The file bytes are externally supplied and remain the hashable source of truth.

artifactTypes.label: Supplied encoded image
artifactTypes.description: An exact supplied encoded image file accepted by the historical working-copy loader, including files whose decode may expose alpha.
sourceNotes: Defined from the encoded source input at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:108-110.
provenanceNotes: This source contract does not imply that a resampled decode preserves native evidence.

artifactTypes.label: Native opaque decode configuration
artifactTypes.description: Pinned EXIF orientation, decoder, preprocessing, color-management, native-size, channel, and pixel-bound settings for opaque decode.
sourceNotes: Makes the behavior-affecting decode policy in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:87-93 a first-class input.
provenanceNotes: The configuration identity must distinguish decoder upgrades and preprocessing changes.

artifactTypes.label: Native opaque sRGB8 raster
artifactTypes.description: The once-decoded, native-dimension, three-channel opaque 8-bit sRGB raster with no resampling.

notes: Stable identity of the supplied encoded artwork image.
Stable identity of this exact native decode.
The native opaque contract admits only decodes with no alpha-bearing pixels.
Inspection paths expose source identity, decode identity, and the opaque success condition without changing raster topology.

sourceNotes: This is the fixed left product anchor and the NativeRaster output in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:82-96.
provenanceNotes: Native dimensions, pixel order, source hash, and decode identity remain available through paired custody metadata.

artifactTypes.label: Native decode provenance
artifactTypes.description: Dimensions, decoder and preprocessing identity, source content hash, and encoded byte count for one native opaque decode.
sourceNotes: Carries the metadata enumerated by research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:89-90.
provenanceNotes: The record is specific to one supplied file and one identified decode configuration.

artifactTypes.label: Fixed working-copy configuration
artifactTypes.description: Declared orientation, alpha flattening, sRGB conversion, max-edge-224, and Lanczos3 settings for the historical region-graph loader.
sourceNotes: Makes every setting listed at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:108-110 explicit.
provenanceNotes: Kernel, edge bound, orientation, color conversion, and matte behavior are consequential configuration identity.

artifactTypes.label: Max-edge-224 Lanczos3 sRGB8 working raster
artifactTypes.description: A three-channel opaque sRGB8 discovery raster resized with the historical max-edge-224 Lanczos3 policy and distinct from native source truth.
sourceNotes: The historical region-graph and SLIC path used this exact max-edge-224 Lanczos3 working raster; current runtime use remains prohibited by the native/no-resampling policy.
provenanceNotes: Carries source identity, working dimensions, kernel, orientation, color conversion, and flattening policy; it must never be substituted for the native raster type.

artifactTypes.label: Native alpha-bearing sRGB8 raster
artifactTypes.description: A native-dimension 8-bit sRGB raster with a genuine alpha channel whose transparency semantics remain intact.
sourceNotes: This is the alpha-bearing raster input required by research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:129-130.
provenanceNotes: Section 2 defines no producer that decodes an encoded file into this alpha-preserving contract.

artifactTypes.label: Transparency policy configuration
artifactTypes.description: A declared refusal-or-flatten policy, including matte color when flattening is selected and a stable policy identity.
sourceNotes: Represents the declared policy input and conditional matte at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:129-130.
provenanceNotes: The policy identity must accompany either refusal or flattening so the content decision is not silent.

artifactTypes.label: Declared transparency refusal
artifactTypes.description: A policy-identified refusal result for a genuinely transparent raster.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Terminates processing of an alpha-bearing input under the declared refusal policy.
sourceNotes: Represents the permitted declared-refusal outcome in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:121-134.
provenanceNotes: The result retains the transparency policy identity and does not claim an opaque raster was produced.

artifactTypes.label: Native matte-flattened sRGB8 raster
artifactTypes.description: A native-dimension opaque sRGB8 raster derived from alpha compositing and explicitly bound to its matte color and policy identity.
sourceNotes: Represents the historical matte-flattened output at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:121-134.
provenanceNotes: The matte becomes image evidence; this contract is distinct from both native opaque source truth and alpha-bearing input.

artifactTypes.label: OKLab conversion configuration
artifactTypes.description: A versioned sRGB-to-OKLab conversion contract covering numerical precision and gamut behavior.
sourceNotes: Makes the precision and gamut-clipping version requirement at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:146-147 explicit.
provenanceNotes: Conversion outputs must retain this configuration identity for deterministic comparison.

artifactTypes.label: Native OKLab pixel raster
artifactTypes.description: One floating OKLab triple for every native source pixel in unchanged pixel order and cardinality.
sourceNotes: Produced by color.oklab-working-space from the native opaque raster and required by family quantization, robust native fitting, and continuous surround mechanisms.
provenanceNotes: Must retain the native raster identity and one-to-one pixel correspondence; it is not a working-raster conversion.

artifactTypes.label: Native-lattice matte-flattened OKLab pixel raster
artifactTypes.description: One floating OKLab triple for every pixel of a native-dimension matte-flattened raster, retaining the matte and policy identity.
sourceNotes: This branch preserves native lattice order but is not native opaque source evidence because the matte has altered pixel values.
provenanceNotes: Retains the alpha source, matte color, transparency policy, conversion identity, dimensions, and one-to-one pixel order.

artifactTypes.label: Declared discovery-raster OKLab samples
artifactTypes.description: OKLab samples on an explicitly declared non-native discovery lattice.
sourceNotes: Produced by color.oklab-working-space only for an explicitly declared non-native discovery lattice and admitted as a distinct robust-fit alternative.
provenanceNotes: Must bind its source raster, lattice, sampling, and color-conversion identities and cannot claim native-pixel cardinality.

artifactTypes.label: Individual OKLab color triple
artifactTypes.description: One floating-point OKLab color value with declared conversion and source or hypothesis provenance; it is not an ordered pixel plane.
sourceNotes: Individual color comparisons require explicit values; the ordered per-pixel conversion is represented by raster-plane artifact types instead.
provenanceNotes: A standalone color must retain its own source or hypothesis identity and cannot imply native pixel-plane cardinality.

artifactTypes.label: OKLab identity region classification
artifactTypes.description: The declared dark-or-light and neutral-or-saturated region classification used to select an identity tolerance.
sourceNotes: Represents the region-classification input at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:159-160.
provenanceNotes: Hard region boundaries and the classification rule are consequential provenance.

artifactTypes.label: Same-color ruler configuration
artifactTypes.description: Criterion-specific regional identity thresholds and a stable ruler identity for same-color judgments.
sourceNotes: Makes the calibrated regional threshold values in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:157-162 first-class.
provenanceNotes: The ruler is identity-specific and must not be silently reused for role functionality or source support.

artifactTypes.label: Same-color judgment
artifactTypes.description: A same-or-different identity decision paired with the applied regional threshold identity.
sourceNotes: Represents the judgment and threshold identity output at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:159-160.
provenanceNotes: The result identifies both the region classification and the exact ruler configuration used.

artifactTypes.label: Source-supported color hypothesis
artifactTypes.description: A color hypothesis with registered observed-source support and lineage sufficient to seek an exact native witness.
sourceNotes: Represents the source-supported color hypothesis input at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:173-174.
provenanceNotes: Source support alone does not assert belonging, representativeness, or role correctness.

artifactTypes.label: Exact native-pixel publication configuration
artifactTypes.description: The declared ordinary-role and stop publication policy requiring literal native source pixels and preserving alias provenance.
sourceNotes: Makes the ordinary exact-pixel rule in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:166-180 an explicit policy input.
provenanceNotes: Policy identity distinguishes literal publication from centroid, interpolation, or generated-average output.

artifactTypes.label: Exact native-pixel witness
artifactTypes.description: A literal RGB triple with native pixel index and coordinates, source hash, lineage, and alias-specific mask or provenance where applicable.
sourceNotes: Represents the exact publication record specified at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:166-180.
provenanceNotes: Exact existence is mechanical custody only and does not prove semantic quality or role fitness.

artifactTypes.label: Complete role tuple
artifactTypes.description: A complete background, surface, foreground, and accent color tuple before explicit collapse legality and final contract metadata are attached.
sourceNotes: Represents the treatment input at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:190 and complete role tuple at :221.
provenanceNotes: Completeness of the tuple does not imply source-connectedness, explicit collapse, legality, or product quality.

artifactTypes.label: Source registry
artifactTypes.description: A registry of observed evidence and registered paths for fields, role directions, families, representatives, and published colors.
sourceNotes: Represents the per-image source-registry input at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:188-191; the census names no separate producer, so this remains an internal runtime gap.
provenanceNotes: Registry membership records historical observed paths and may include abstractions weaker than exact-pixel custody.

artifactTypes.label: Source-connected lineage configuration
artifactTypes.description: The historical descriptor coverage and eligibility rules used to evaluate source-connected treatment custody.
sourceNotes: Makes the registered-path eligibility rule in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:182-195 explicit.
provenanceNotes: The configuration is historical and must not be mistaken for the current ordinary exact-pixel contract.

artifactTypes.label: Source-connected lineage record
artifactTypes.description: Per-descriptor source-connection booleans and an eligible-or-ineligible historical lineage result for one treatment.
sourceNotes: Represents the historical lineage output at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:190-195.
provenanceNotes: Eligibility under this record is weaker than an exact native-pixel witness and does not prove quality.

artifactTypes.label: Complete infeasible source domain
artifactTypes.description: A complete source-supported treatment domain for which no legal two-color treatment remains under the declared search boundary.
sourceNotes: Represents the complete infeasible source domain input at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:205-206.
provenanceNotes: Completeness and infeasibility are scoped claims; they cannot establish the semantic phrase genuinely no other way.

artifactTypes.label: Exact black-or-white emergency diagnosis
artifactTypes.description: An exact diagnosis carrying generated-color absence, supported-pair counts, contrast evidence, and the diagnosed emergency placement.
sourceNotes: Represents the exact emergency diagnosis input at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:205-206.
provenanceNotes: The diagnosis retains the evidence needed to validate the structural emergency shadow.

artifactTypes.label: Black-or-white escape configuration
artifactTypes.description: The declared emergency policy restricting generation to exactly one absent pure black or white role and requiring its partner to collapse.
sourceNotes: Makes the exact emergency form in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:197-211 a first-class policy input.
provenanceNotes: The policy identity is required to distinguish this narrow escape from eager generated-color fallback.

artifactTypes.label: Declared black-or-white emergency escape treatment
artifactTypes.description: A complete declared emergency treatment containing exactly one absent pure black or white color in background or foreground, its collapsed partner, pair counts, and contrast evidence.
sourceNotes: Represents the escape-treatment branch at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:197-211.
provenanceNotes: This emergency contract remains distinct from ordinary exact-native publication and from a generic collapse result.

artifactTypes.label: Black-or-white escape abstention
artifactTypes.description: An explicit no-escape result retaining the supported-pair counts and contrast evidence considered by emergency arbitration.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Records explicit abstention instead of manufacturing an emergency treatment.
sourceNotes: Represents the abstention branch at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:205-206.
provenanceNotes: Abstention retains the exact diagnosis and policy identity that prevented escape publication.

artifactTypes.label: Explicit collapse configuration
artifactTypes.description: The exact equality, flag-consistency, role-cardinality, and collapsed-surface gradient legality rules for role collapse.
sourceNotes: Makes the explicit flag and legality contract at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:213-225 a first-class input.
provenanceNotes: The rules distinguish deliberate equality from an accidental duplicate hex value.

artifactTypes.label: Explicit role-collapse result
artifactTypes.description: Exact surface-to-background and accent-to-foreground collapse flags, resulting role cardinality, and a legality result for one complete role tuple.
sourceNotes: Represents the collapse flags, cardinality, and legality output at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:221-224.
provenanceNotes: This contract is distinct from the emergency escape form and records invalid unflagged equality explicitly.

This fragment asserts typed candidate compatibility only; it adds no graph bindings, architecture, runtime pipeline, dependency order, or build order.
Native opaque, resampled, alpha-bearing, matte-flattened, exact-native witness, source-connected lineage, emergency escape, and explicit collapse contracts remain distinct artifact types.

All supplied encoded source and configuration artifacts are expected external roots; the alpha-bearing decoded raster is unresolved external because Section 2 supplies no alpha-preserving decode producer.
